item.title: Kubernetes Postfix
item.author: Lorenzo Girardi
item.description: Long story short: my VPS provider changed the price for their small instance from $1 to $3, so I took the opportunity to move my Postfix service from cloud to on-premises. Why move away from cloud when the rest of the world is moving toward it? Because my own domain is used primarily for alerting, and the cost/benefit stopped making sense at $3/month.
